name: OnFRA — Onfra Financial Intelligence Agent
description: OnFRA (OnChain Financial Reputation Agent) analyzes Celo wallet activity into financial reputation signals (health, income, reputation, loan capacity), settles paid agent calls in USDT via x402, and can attest verified REP passports onchain. Available at https://app.onfra.xyz. ERC-8004 agent #9219.

x402.enforcement: Agent/API callers pay via x402. Cached signal GETs and REP verify are free. External analyze/chat/statement: 0.01 USDT. Verified REP report: 0.10 USDT. Unpaid paid endpoints return HTTP 402 with machine-readable accepts[].

paymentRequiredBody.retry: Sign EIP-3009 USDT auth for accepts[0].maxAmountRequired to accepts[0].payTo, then resubmit with X-PAYMENT

onChainActions.name: USDT x402 settlement
onChainActions.description: Paid API/agent calls settle USDT on Celo mainnet to the OnFRA treasury (payTo from /api/x402/config or /api/health/integrations).

onChainActions.name: REP passport attestation
onChainActions.description: After a paid verified report, OnFRA publishes the report hash onchain via OnchainReporter.publishFinancialReport so lenders can verify without trusting the API alone.

onChainActions.name: REP passport verify
onChainActions.description: Anyone can verify a REP-{id} / WP-{id} against the onchain registry (free). Reads OnchainReporter.verifyReport.

onChainActions.name: ERC-8004 agent identity
onChainActions.description: OnFRA is registered as ERC-8004 agent #9219 on Celo mainnet Identity Registry.
onChainActions.note: Identity/reputation registries are onchain; analysis itself reads public Celo wallet history (off-API compute).

tee.note: Agent runs on Vercel serverless at app.onfra.xyz.

skills.name: Wallet Financial Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes transaction history, cash flow, wallet age, and asset composition to produce Financial Health Scores and cash-flow statements.

skills.name: Wallet Reputation Scoring
skills.description: Evaluates wallet maturity, transaction consistency, protocol trust, and long-term financial reliability.

skills.name: Income Stability Assessment
skills.description: Detects recurring income streams and classifies income stability over time.

skills.name: Portfolio Risk Exposure
skills.description: Analyzes stablecoin, volatile, DeFi, and NFT allocation to classify portfolio risk.

skills.name: Loan Capacity Estimate
skills.description: Estimates responsible borrowing range from income stability, reputation, and risk signals.

skills.name: Verified Financial Reputation Report
skills.description: Premium lender-ready attestation with verification code, report hash published onchain via OnchainReporter, and IPFS pin.
